_: russian-ids.json — the number in each Russian note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <Word field> (an alphabet or sounds row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates (the second card is <id>~2), so this pins both schedules. APPLIED by russian-fix.js (the level decks and the phrases) and by build-russian-sounds.js (the alphabet and the sounds deck). NEVER delete or renumber a row: a removed note's row moves to _retired, a rename renames the key. Seeded 2026-11-19 from the eight decks as shipped.
